title: 真实CONNECT出口：按请求目标授权，透明传递TCP字节，保留单隧道与空闲预算
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)返回深拷贝，将原tunnel虚拟主机domains限制为[permitted.invalid:443]；原CONNECT终止配置、2秒idle、单上游连接/一个等待请求、固定上游、健康与普通方法规则全部保留。增加默认虚拟主机，对CONNECT返回403，/health保持200/ready，其余方法405。实际HTTP1.1 CONNECT授权看请求目标及端口，不让伪造Host把bad.invalid:443变成允许；批准目标即使Host不同仍按批准目标选择。握手成功后原样转交NUL及看似HTTP的内部字节，不能二次解释。第二隧道有界等待，第三隧道503不接新上游；关闭原连接后等待者取得连接，空闲到期实际释放。不能改成开放转发任意域名、增加连接/等待上限或关闭空闲约束。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13 HTTP1.1 CONNECT termination与私有TCP字节回显服务，明确匹配CONNECT target而非普通HTTP Host。批准名字映射到固定回环上游，不执行外部DNS或任意目标拨号；内部字节包含HTTP样式仅证明不被二次解析，不声称已完成端到端TLS、目标应用鉴权、H2多路复用或CONNECT-UDP验收。隧道会转交不经HTTP层清洗的原始字节，必须由目标协议独立授权，不能把该入口称通用安全代理。单进程有限连接/idle预算在自有连接验证，不触外部网络，不构建镜像。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    manager=result["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"][0]["filters"][0]["typed_config"]
    approved=manager["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]
    approved["domains"]=["permitted.invalid:443"]
    health=copy.deepcopy(approved["routes"][0])
    rejected={"name":"rejected-target","domains":["*"],"routes":[health,
        {"match":{"connect_matcher":{}},"direct_response":{"status":403}},
        {"match":{"prefix":"/"},"direct_response":{"status":405}}]}
    manager["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"].append(rejected)
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
交付允许的目的域名和端口、CONNECT匹配规则、代理终止还是转发隧道的模式，以及解析后的地址限制。允许CONNECT不能等同任意TCP出口，否则可能访问内部管理地址或未授权端口。验收合法目标、IP直连、名称解析变化、错误端口和长时间空闲隧道，检查授权在建立通道前完成。交付HTTP/1与HTTP/2多路复用下的资源预算和取消传播，隧道建立200不代表上层协议成功。若过滤链包含不适合升级流的全体缓冲，应明确移除或专用链；安全边界由实际连接目标证明，不只看Host字符串。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围
交付专用请求矩阵和实际目标证据
明确版本、资源与失败策略

test_files.checks/check.py:
import concurrent.futures,copy,json,pathlib,socket,socketserver,sys,threading,time,urllib.parse
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,bootstrap,hcm
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
records=[];lock=threading.Lock()
class Handler(socketserver.BaseRequestHandler):
 def handle(self):
  with lock:records.append(dict(peer=self.client_address,received=b""))
  row=records[-1]
  try:
   self.request.sendall(b"READY\n")
   while True:
    raw=self.request.recv(65536)
    if not raw:break
    with lock:row["received"]+=raw
    self.request.sendall(raw)
  except OSError:pass
class Backend(socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer):allow_reuse_address=True;daemon_threads=True
backend=Backend(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler);thread=threading.Thread(target=lambda:backend.serve_forever(poll_interval=.02),daemon=True);thread.start()
def connect(server,target,host=None):
 address=urllib.parse.urlparse(server.base);peer=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",address.port),timeout=2);peer.settimeout(3)
 peer.sendall(("CONNECT "+target+" HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: "+(host or target)+"\r\n\r\n").encode())
 raw=b""
 try:
  while b"\r\n\r\n" not in raw:
   part=peer.recv(4096);assert part,"CONNECT closed without response"
   raw+=part;assert len(raw)<32768
 except OSError as exc:peer.close();raise AssertionError("CONNECT handshake failed") from exc
 head,body=raw.split(b"\r\n\r\n",1);status=int(head.split()[1])
 return peer,status,body
def exact(peer,initial,want):
 raw=initial
 try:
  while len(raw)<len(want):
   part=peer.recv(len(want)-len(raw));assert part
   raw+=part
 except OSError as exc:raise AssertionError("raw tunnel reply absent") from exc
 assert raw==want,(raw,want)
try:
 base=bootstrap(backend.server_address[1]);manager=hcm(base);manager["upgrade_configs"]=[{"upgrade_type":"CONNECT"}]
 health={"match":{"path":"/health"},"direct_response":{"status":200,"body":{"inline_string":"ready"}}}
 manager["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]=[health,
  {"match":{"connect_matcher":{}},"route":{"cluster":"service","timeout":"0s","idle_timeout":"2s","upgrade_configs":[{"upgrade_type":"CONNECT","connect_config":{}}]}},
  {"match":{"prefix":"/"},"direct_response":{"status":405}}]
 cluster=base["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]
 cluster["circuit_breakers"]={"thresholds":[{"priority":"DEFAULT","max_connections":1,"max_pending_requests":1}]}
 with Envoy(base) as old:
  peer,status,body=connect(old,"bad.invalid:443")
  try:assert status==200;exact(peer,body,b"READY\n")
  finally:peer.close()
 print("NATIVE_CONNECT_WILDCARD_BASELINE_ACTUALLY_OPENS_UNAPPROVED_TARGET_TUNNEL",flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy(base)
 print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: CONNECT request-target allowlist with finite TCP tunnel",flush=True)
 fixed=task.configure(base);assert base==before
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  for target,host in [("bad.invalid:443",None),("bad.invalid:443","permitted.invalid:443"),("permitted.invalid:80",None),("permitted.invalid.evil:443",None)]:
   count=len(records);peer,status,body=connect(server,target,host)
   peer.close();assert status==403 and len(records)==count,("unapproved CONNECT target reached TCP",target,host,status)
  first,status,body=connect(server,"permitted.invalid:443","bad.invalid:443")
  try:
   assert status==200;exact(first,body,b"READY\n")
   for payload in [b"approved\x00binary",b"GET /inner HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: opaque\r\n\r\n"]:
    first.sendall(payload);exact(first,b"",payload)
   pool=concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
   future=pool.submit(connect,server,"permitted.invalid:443")
   deadline=time.monotonic()+1
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if server.stats().get("cluster.service.upstream_rq_pending_active")==1:break
    first.sendall(b"keep-active");exact(first,b"",b"keep-active");time.sleep(.02)
   assert not future.done() and server.stats().get("cluster.service.upstream_rq_pending_active")==1,"second tunnel was not queued"
   count=len(records);overflow,status,body=connect(server,"permitted.invalid:443");overflow.close()
   assert status==503 and len(records)==count,"third tunnel exceeded approved one-active/one-pending budget"
  finally:first.close()
  third,status,body=future.result(timeout=3);pool.shutdown(wait=True)
  try:
   assert status==200;exact(third,body,b"READY\n")
   third.sendall(b"after-close");exact(third,b"",b"after-close")
   third.settimeout(4);assert third.recv(1)==b"","idle budget did not close unused tunnel"
  finally:third.close()
  assert server.request("/health")[:2]==(200,b"ready")
  assert server.request("/ordinary")[0]==405
  assert fixed["static_resources"]["clusters"]==base["static_resources"]["clusters"] and hcm(fixed)["upgrade_configs"]==manager["upgrade_configs"]
  approved=hcm(fixed)["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]
  assert approved["domains"]==["permitted.invalid:443"] and approved["routes"]==manager["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]
  payloads=[row["received"] for row in records]
  assert any(b"approved\x00binary" in value for value in payloads) and not any(value.startswith(b"CONNECT ") for value in payloads)
 print("NATIVE_CONNECT_TARGET_NOT_HOST_AUTHORIZE_BINARY_TCP_TERMINATION_ONE_ACTIVE_ONE_PENDING_IDLE_RELEASE_HEALTH_RETAINED",flush=True)
finally:backend.shutdown();backend.server_close();thread.join(2)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
